description: Executive Command Center design focusing on data density, absolute clarity, and a premium SaaS aesthetic (Palantir/Bloomberg meets Datadog/Linear).

rules: No Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk, or generic templates fonts.
Headings use Cabinet Grotesk with tight tracking.
All KPIs, SLA metrics, IP addresses, and logs must use JetBrains Mono.

charts.rules: Avoid purple/violet and teal gradients completely. Stick to Azure, Amber, Emerald, and Crimson for logical AIOps semantic mapping.

light.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-gray-200

dark.card: bg-[#121218] border border-[#27272A] rounded-lg shadow-none relative overflow-hidden
dark.card_glow: after:absolute after:inset-0 after:rounded-lg after:ring-1 after:ring-inset after:ring-white/5
dark.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0E]/80 border-b border-[#27272A]

components.cards: Strictly flat rectangular or subtly rounded (8px max). Do not overuse soft shadows. Focus on 1px borders.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid Azure/Blue with white text. Secondary: Outline with transparent bg, text matches border color on hover.
components.tables: Dense, numeric columns right-aligned, status badges (pill shaped), hover states on rows (bg-surface_hover).
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn charts. Use strict categorical palette. No backgrounds on chart containers (let the grid provide the structure). Tooltips must have dark/light theme matching.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Dark mode: bg-[#121218] border-[#27272A] focus:ring-primary.
components.navigation: Enterprise sidebar navigation. Collapsible (icon only) to maximize workspace. Active state: bg-surface_hover with primary color left-border accent.

motion.philosophy: Micro-interactions for feedback. No decorative bouncing.
motion.hover: Transition transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. Very slight scale (1.01) on interactive cards.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for widgets. (Framer motion: initial={{opacity: 0, y: 10}} animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}} transition={{staggerChildren: 0.1}})
motion.data_updates: Number counters for KPIs when data changes.

hero_approach.layout: Command Center Entry. Left-aligned typography, high-impact value proposition.
hero_approach.visuals: Abstract data flows or maturity radar chart hero visualization. Not a generic photo.
hero_approach.cta: Launch Command Center | Run Maturity Assessment

hero_backgrounds.description: Modern server room with blue illumination, ideal for the abstract NOC/AIOps tech background.
Wires managing centralized resource of server in data center, can be used for connectivity/cloud ops abstract.

media_and_images.rules: Never use placeholder images. If specific icons/avatars are needed, use Lucide-react or UI defaults.

attributes: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid. Examples: data-testid='kpi-card-mttr', data-testid='nav-sre-module'.
